versions.changelog:
Major update: The 3q-quality-system skill has been refactored and streamlined with new frameworks and usage guidelines.

- Added comprehensive new references and templates (daily check, decision checklist, three dimensions).
- Removed legacy documentation, examples, and older skill modules.
- Expanded and clarified the 3Q system’s multi-layered quality assurance process, including Layer 0 (pre-checks), rapid 3Q, cognitive lens, and blind review workflows.
- Introduced new triggers, automation criteria, and detailed scoring system for quality evaluation.
- Improved decision support, error self-correction, and framework update mechanics.
- Clearly documented new usage scenarios, step-by-step onboarding, and provided rich reference materials for daily and strategic quality checks.

3q-quality-system v4.0.1

- Removed install.sh and quality-dashboard (SKILL.md) to simplify installation and reduce redundancy.
- Added MANUAL-INSTALL.md with updated manual installation instructions.
- SKILL.md revised: now focuses on unified trigger and intelligent dispatch, simplifying usage to one main trigger phrase.
- Dashboard and bundled file count reduced (from 9 to 8 skills); scenarios & instructions updated accordingly.
- Enhanced core principles section in documentation; added detailed "13 问三层结构" explanation and value proposition.

3q-quality-system v4.0.0 introduces a comprehensive metacognitive quality assurance bundle.

- Integrates 9 quality assurance skills, including 6 core and 3 auxiliary modules.
- Adds auto-trigger, task breakdown, decision checklist, subagent template, and visual dashboard.
- Supports quality checks before document publishing, code commits, major decisions, subagent tasks, and content releases.
- Demonstrates significant improvement in quality metrics (rework rate, delivery time, premium output).
- Includes quick-start guides for installation and usage.
